job.title: Senior AV Consultant - AV Systems Designer
job.description:
London South East / Remote based with 1-2 days per week in London office

A We are working with a highly regarded international design consultancy delivering some of the world’s most exciting sports, entertainment and experiential projects.

Due to continued growth, they are looking for an experienced AV Design Consultant to join their specialist audiovisual team, working on major projects from initial concept and design through to construction and commissioning.
The Role Working closely with clients, architects and multidisciplinary design teams, you will be responsible for the design and delivery of sophisticated AV systems across major venues and experiential environments.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing AV design briefs through client and stakeholder engagement
  • Professional audio and PAVA systems design, including EASE modelling
  • Video systems including large-format displays, IPTV and external connectivity
  • AV infrastructure design including data, power and containment requirements
  • Production of system schematics, specifications and tender documentation
  • Specialist AV including immersive audio, interactive technologies and projection mapping
  • Reviewing tender submissions and monitoring installation
  • Supporting commissioning, testing and optimisation with AV integrators
About You You will have proven experience in audiovisual design, ideally within an AV or engineering consultancy.

Experience designing systems for stadia, arenas, sports, entertainment or other complex public venues would be particularly desirable.

You will combine strong technical AV knowledge with excellent client-facing skills and be comfortable working alongside architects, engineers and wider project teams.

Knowledge of broadcast systems would also be advantageous.
For more experienced candidates, there is scope to lead major international projects, manage key client relationships and contribute to the continued growth of the AV practice.

Interested? Apply today or contact IN2-AV Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Commercial Field AV Engineer - North America
job.description:
About the Opportunity

Do you love being on the road? Are you happiest on site, overseeing teams on the ground and leading from the front?

At IN2-AV, we are currently recruiting on behalf of a fast-growing, globally recognised digital experience agency. They design and deliver bespoke, immersive audio-visual environments for some of the world's most high-profile brands across Retail, Hospitality, and Leisure.

They are expanding their North American operations and looking for an experienced Lead Commercial Field AV Engineer who thrives on travel, technically challenging installations, and site leadership.

What You Will Do

As the Lead Commercial Field AV Engineer, you will be the technical authority on site, taking ownership of high-impact deployments across North America from initial site prep to final client handover.

  • Lead from the Front: Supervise and direct installation crews, sub-contractors, and engineering teams on site to ensure quality, safety, and precision execution.
  • Deliver Cutting-Edge Tech: Oversee complex installations featuring high-density LED displays, interactive Digital Signage networks, dynamic Projection Mapping, and integrated control environments.
  • Commissioning & Systems Setup: Test, configure, and commission audio-visual control platforms and DSPs (such as Q-SYS, Crestron, Extron, and Dante).
  • On-Site Problem Solving: Solve real-time technical, networking, and mounting challenges in fast-paced commercial environments.
  • Client Handover: Coordinate with general contractors and brand representatives to perform final walk-throughs and system handovers.

What We Are Looking For
  • Commercial AV Expertise: Proven track record as a Senior or Lead AV Engineer delivering commercial installations in Retail, Hospitality, or Leisure sectors.
  • Site Management Skills: Demonstrated ability to lead site operations, coordinate installation teams, and maintain high standards of quality control.
  • Core Tech Knowledge: Hands-on experience with LED hardware, projection technology, commercial rack builds, and IP-based AV networking.
  • Control Systems Experience: Working knowledge of Q-SYS, Crestron, Extron, or similar commercial control ecosystems.
  • Flexibility for Travel: Passion for life on the road with the availability for extensive travel across North America.

What Is On Offer
  • High-Visibility Projects: Work on flagship experiential projects seen by millions.
  • Career Progression: Join an expanding global agency with clear avenues for senior technical growth.
  • Full Travel Support: Comprehensive travel package, allowances, and competitive field rates.
  • Competitive Compensation: Attractive base salary, bonus scheme, pension/401(k), healthcare, and ongoing certification support.

How to Apply

Ready to take your field engineering skills across North America? Apply directly through IN2-AV today with your updated CV highlighting your site leadership and commercial AV experience.

job.description:

Are you a technical AV specialist who thrives on delivering high-impact, immersive technology for world-class brands?

At IN2-AV, we are currently recruiting on behalf of a leading global digital experience agency that designs and installs cutting-edge technology environments across Retail, Hospitality, and Quick Service Restaurants (QSR).

They are seeking an experienced Senior AV Project Manager with a solid engineering background to lead bespoke, large-scale audio-visual integration projects. If you enjoy taking complex, ambitious technology designs off the page and making them come to life on site, this is the perfect opportunity.

What You Will Do

As Senior AV Project Manager, you will take end-to-end ownership of client deployments across the UK and internationally - managing projects from initial site surveys right through to commissioning and hand-off.

  • Lead Bespoke Deployments: Manage the delivery of high-profile AV projects, including large-scale LED displays, interactive Digital Signage, dynamic Projection Mapping, and fully automated AV Control Systems.
  • Technical Leadership: Draw on your engineering background to collaborate effectively with design teams, software specialists, site engineers, and third-party contractors to guarantee smooth execution.
  • Client & Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary technical contact for global brands, retail architects, main contractors, and internal delivery teams.
  • On-Site Management: Oversee site teams, installation crews, health and safety compliance, and system commissioning in fast-paced commercial environments.

What We Are Looking For
  • Engineering Background: You started your career as an AV Systems or Installation Engineer before moving into Project Management. You understand rack builds, cable infrastructure, signal flow, and mounting requirements in real-world environments.

  • Networking Knowledge: Solid understanding of IP-based AV distribution, control networks, and system architecture.
  • Strong Communication Skills: Ability to translate complex technical details into clear project milestones for clients and contractors alike.
  • Certifications (Desirable): CTS / CTS-D / CTS-I, Prince2, PMP, or manufacturer training (Q-SYS, Crestron, Dante).

job.title: AV Installation Engineer
job.description:
Installation Engineer – AV Projects (London)

Representing our client – IN2-AV Recruitment

IN2-AV Recruitment is working on behalf of a fast-growing, well-established Audio Visual integration specialist with a strong reputation for delivering high quality AV and VC solutions across the UK and Europe. With a supportive culture, ongoing manufacturer training and clear professional development pathways, this is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Installation Engineer looking to step into a more senior, hands-on role.

The Opportunity

 Our client is seeking an experienced AV Installation Engineer to take technical ownership of first and second fix installations on a wide range of commercial AV projects. This is a senior, field-based role suited to someone who enjoys autonomy, problem solving and delivering well-executed installations with pride.

You will act as the technical lead on site, working independently, supporting subcontractors, collaborating with project teams and representing the business professionally to customers. For candidates looking to expand into commissioning, there is also room to progress.

Key Responsibilities
  • Deliver high quality first and second fix installations for AV, VC and control systems.
  • Take technical lead on site, ensuring work is completed safely, on time and to scope.
  • Build and wire equipment racks to industry standards.
  • Review drawings and documentation, raising issues and suggesting improvements.
  • Test and verify cabling, signal paths, network settings and device configuration.
  • Support fault finding, firmware updates and configuration adjustments during commissioning.
  • Assist the service team on complex or escalated maintenance tasks when required.
  • Maintain professional site standards and complete all relevant documentation.
Skills and Experience Required
  • Strong hands-on experience with AV cabling, racking, terminations and hardware installation.
  • Confident understanding of digital audio and video signal flows.
  • Familiarity with protocols such as HDMI, HDBaseT, Dante and USB-C.
  • Ability to work with control and DSP platforms including uploading and testing configuration files (Crestron, QSC, Extron, Biamp).
  • Able to read CAD drawings, cable schedules and schematics.
  • Skilled with test equipment and experienced with networked AV including switches, VLANs and IP configuration.
  • Professional communicator who is calm under pressure and able to work independently.
  • Flexible to travel across the UK and occasionally Europe.
Qualifications Essential
  • CSCS or ECS card
  • Full UK driving licence
  • Valid passport
Desirable
  • Manufacturer training (Crestron, QSC, Biamp, Extron)
  • IPAF, PASMA
  • AVIXA CTS or CTS I
Why Apply
  • Senior level autonomy and technical ownership on exciting AV projects.
  • Structured onboarding and manufacturer-led training.
  • Supportive culture with strong teamwork and development opportunities.
  • Growing organisation with long term progression potential.
If you are an experienced AV Installation Engineer who takes pride in delivering high standards and wants to join a company that values expertise and teamwork, IN2-AV Recruitment would love to hear from you.

job.title: AV Commissioning Engineer
job.description:
If you are an experienced AV Commissioning Engineer looking for a role where you can actually take ownership of your projects and work with a top-tier team, this one is worth a look.

I am working with a fast-growing audio-visual systems integrator (now circa 45 people) with a busy pipeline of high-end projects across the UK and Europe. The culture here is excellent, with sales, delivery, and engineering actually backing each other up and making a point of celebrating their wins together.

You will be responsible for overseeing the installation, testing, and full on-site commissioning of various AV systems, ensuring everything works to specification and meets the client's needs.

Your time will be split between hands-on technical work and project closure:

  • Reporting and Management (10%): Vetting closure reports, managing "as-built vs. as-drawn" updates, and attending monthly improvement and team meetings.

  • Ability to work under pressure, multitask, and problem-solve on-site without walking away from a challenge.
  • A clean driving licence.
  • Desirable: Crestron P101/P102, QSC, Extron, or control system programming skills.

On offer:

  • Circa £40,000 to £45,000 basic salary
  • Car allowance
  • Company benefits package

If you want to join a team that values quality standards, invests in your training, and keeps a solid pipeline of work on the books without the corporate nonsense, apply via the link or get in touch with the team at IN2-AV to discuss the role in more detail.
